# Tracker

Kind: local
Issues: docs/deep-mode/issues/
Labels use the role names spec, ticket, enhancement, bug, triage:new and triage:agent-ready.
Create one Markdown file per issue named NNNN-slug.md, with Status, Labels, Parent and Blocked by header lines. Use four-digit issue IDs; use none for absent parents or blockers.
README.txt: A local planning workspace for a community tool library. There is no remote tracker.
